title: Temporary files
explanation: Only .tmp, .temp and .log files older than seven days. Review carefully: applications may retain useful work or diagnostic logs here.

title: DirectX shader cache
explanation: Compiled graphics shaders older than three days. Games may briefly stutter while rebuilding this cache.

title: NVIDIA DirectX cache
explanation: NVIDIA DirectX shader cache. Graphics applications recreate it; the first launch may be slower.

title: NVIDIA OpenGL cache
explanation: NVIDIA OpenGL shader cache. Graphics applications recreate it; the first launch may be slower.

title: NVIDIA compute cache
explanation: Compiled compute kernels. CUDA applications may take longer to start while rebuilding them.

title: AMD DirectX cache
explanation: AMD DirectX shader cache. Games may briefly stutter while rebuilding this cache.

title: AMD OpenGL cache
explanation: AMD OpenGL shader cache. Graphics applications recreate it; the first launch may be slower.

title: Chrome website cache
explanation: Default profile website cache only. Close Chrome first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Chrome code cache
explanation: Default profile code cache only. Close Chrome first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Chrome GPU cache
explanation: Default profile GPU cache only. Close Chrome first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Edge website cache
explanation: Default profile website cache only. Close Edge first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Edge code cache
explanation: Default profile code cache only. Close Edge first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Edge GPU cache
explanation: Default profile GPU cache only. Close Edge first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Brave website cache
explanation: Default profile website cache only. Close Brave first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: Brave code cache
explanation: Default profile code cache only. Close Brave first. Cached content is regenerated. Cookies, saved passwords, bookmarks and browsing history are outside this rule.

title: npm package cache
explanation: Stop package installations first. Projects and node_modules are outside this rule. Packages may need downloading again.

title: pip download cache
explanation: Stop pip first. Environments and installed packages are outside this rule. Offline installs may lose cached downloads.

title: NuGet HTTP cache
explanation: Stop builds and restores first. The installed global-package folder is outside this rule.

title: Explorer thumbnail cache
explanation: Active databases are usually locked and are skipped. Explorer regenerates this cache when needed.

title: Explorer icon cache
explanation: Active databases are usually locked and are skipped. Explorer regenerates this cache when needed.

title: Archived error reports
explanation: Archived Windows Error Reporting files older than thirty days. Removing them loses diagnostic evidence; keep reports needed for troubleshooting.
